messages:
elaine_support: Customer on Acme integration reports OOS error when using function/tool calling. They say the returned args are invalid JSON so our client fails to parse and crashes. Posting logs and repro below. 

elaine_support: repro steps:
1) POST /v1/chat/completions with model=redwood-large-2026-03 json mode on and function schema for `create_order`.
2) payload in body -> see snippet.
3) client receives 200 but payload `function_call.arguments` fails JSON.parse with SyntaxError.

elaine_support: sample request (redacted):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-large-2026-03",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"create order: sku ABC, qty 3"}],
  "functions": [{"name":"create_order","parameters": {"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array"}}}}],
  "json_mode": true
}
```

elaine_support: raw model response (function call block):
```json
{"name":"create_order","arguments":"{\"items\": [{\"sku\": \"ABC\", \"qty\": 3}, , {\"sku\": \"DEF\", \"qty\": 1}], \"metadata\": null }"}
```

elaine_support: Notice the extra comma between array entries and the whole arguments value is a string (escaped JSON) instead of an object. Client does JSON.parse on arguments expecting object and fails. Customer impact: order flow fails; reported 2nd request retried then succeeded but flaky. Severity: P1 for Acme (revenue).

sam_engineer: @elaine_support thanks. Can you paste the request_id and the response headers? Also which SDK or client did they use?

elaine_support: request_id: req_2026-03-17_aca123, route: /v1/chat/completions, sdk: nodejs@latest, region: us-west-2. Attached customer stacktrace shows JSON.parse error at sdk/json.js:42.

kevin_oncall: deploy-bot, any recent model swaps or config changes for redwood-large-2026-03 in us-west-2? :thinking:
extra:
deploy-bot: recent deploys for redwood-large-2026-03: 2026-03-16 22:01 UTC swapped variant -> redwood-large-2026-03-opt2 (weight 100). No infra changes.

sam_engineer: I can repro locally with the same model variant. Running a quick run, I see the model emitting `function_call.arguments` as a string in our streaming frames when messages include embedded quotes and escaped chars. Looks like the tokenizer/kernel update changed how the runtime applies json-mode postprocessing, occasionally double-escaping and not normalizing trailing commas.

talia_sre: Possible schema drift after the kernel update on 2026-03-16. Recommend immediate mitigation: 1) Add a conservative post-processor in the SDK to attempt safe repair: if typeof args === 'string' then try JSON.parse, if fails try sanitize (remove trailing commas, fix lone commas). 2) Roll back model variant to previous build in us-west-2 for critical customers while we patch runtime.

sam_engineer: I'll put up a hotfix to runtime postprocessing to prefer parsed objects and run small sanitization heuristics. Pushing a canary now to staging, then to us-west-2 canary pool.

kevin_oncall: Jordan, can you notify Acme CS and switch them to the fallback route (dedicated node pool still on prev variant) until we confirm fix? Mention workaround in the SDK: install @redwood/sdk v3.4.2 which includes arguments sanitization shim. :white_check_mark:
closing_notes:
jordan_csd: Notified account, they accepted temporary switch to dedicated pool. Monitoring for 1h.

sam_engineer: Followups: collect any more failing request_ids, I'll add heuristics for: unquoted keys, trailing commas, and arguments returned as escaped-string. We'll add a regression test to the eval harness to detect escaped-argument regression.

elaine_support: marking this thread escalated -> eng-runtime. I created a support ticket and tagged P1. Thanks all. :pray:
